prior_information: The primary and sensitivity estimates, preliminary six-case intersection-union p-values, and ellipse zero-inclusion geometry were already inspected. This is a reporting and implementation record, not prospective registration.
target: The same case-specific population projection gap delta=w*theta; no outcome model or horizon is changed.

intersection_union_test.p_value: max of the two marginal two-sided asymptotic normal p-values
intersection_union_test.requirements: Valid nondegenerate coordinate inference; dependence between coordinates is allowed.

joint_ellipse.critical_value: chi-square with two degrees of freedom
joint_ellipse.bounds: Global minimum and maximum of w*theta over the estimated joint ellipse
joint_ellipse.requirements: Joint Gaussian limit and a positive-definite two-coordinate long-run covariance.

verification: Independently check ellipse optimisation and all six diagnostic p-values; retain every case.
scope: Supplementary post-estimation inference. Preserve the primary interval, adverse sensitivities and causal assumptions. No significance-driven refitting, exclusions, new preferred horizon or new data vintage.
interpretation: Report any rejection by procedure and sample. A diagnostic rejection does not replace an effect-size interval, establish robustness to the component construction, or identify causal transmission.
